extractionPurpose: Machine-readable extraction of the DGO HTTP Flow Registry provisioning workbook: the seven DGO_HTTPFlow* governance lists, their 101 custom fields and schema XML, configuration seeds, views, unique-key controls, list settings, action graph, REST request catalogue, status vocabulary, final-report contract and recorded design observations.

integrityPolicy.cellValueHandling: Cell values are extracted as stored, with null for blank cells. Numbers stay numbers and text stays text; nothing is coerced, reworded or reordered.
integrityPolicy.designTimeOnly: Every executionEvidence value is the workbook's own design-time wording. "Defined" means the flow is configured to create the resource, not that the resource exists. Run history or the Compose_Final_Report_JSON output is the only evidence of an actual outcome.

registry.expectedResources: 7 lists; 101 custom fields; 7 unique keys; 12 enabled seeds; 7 custom views
registry.executionStatus: Not determinable from the design-time definition. “Defined” means intended/configured in the flow, not proven created. Use the final report JSON or Power Automate run history to populate actual Succeeded, Failed, Skipped, or TimedOut outcomes.
registry.securityNote: The source definition contains tenant site and connection identifiers. This workbook records functional connection references but does not include credentials or secret values.

fields.purpose: The Logic Apps workflow id: 32 hexadecimal characters, no dashes, recorded alongside FlowId so the exported definitions and the tenant register can be joined. GOV-06 measured the gap: 77 exported definitions keyed by a 36-character dashed Power Automate flow GUID, a register of 51 workflows keyed by a 32-hex workflow id, and ZERO exported definitions carrying an id the register knows. Joining on normalised display name matches 13. This column is where the two identifiers sit in one row. Optional, because 21 of the 77 carry no HTTP trigger and so have no trigger URL to read an id from.

risksAndControls.observation: Definition does not contain actual run outputs
risksAndControls.recommendedControl: Do not treat Defined as Created. Export Compose_Final_Report_JSON and run history.

risksAndControls.observation: Required numeric and Boolean fields have no declared defaults
risksAndControls.recommendedControl: All item-creation flows must supply values explicitly.

risksAndControls.observation: Many governance dimensions are unrestricted Text fields
risksAndControls.recommendedControl: Use Choice fields or enforce value dictionaries in producer flows.

risksAndControls.observation: Owner fields are Text rather than Person/Group
risksAndControls.recommendedControl: Add validation or migrate to directory-backed person fields where appropriate.

risksAndControls.observation: RegistryKey relationships are logical Text links
Immutability is descriptive, not technically enforced
risksAndControls.recommendedControl: Use permissions, retention/record controls, or append-only integration design.

risksAndControls.observation: Final validation checks titles, not CAML or field order

risksAndControls.recommendedControl: Validate ConfigValue, ValueType, IsSecret and description.

risksAndControls.observation: ContentBytes is populated with string JSON
risksAndControls.recommendedControl: Confirm connector accepts this; Base64 may be required depending on action behavior.

risksAndControls.observation: Many downstream actions require prior Succeeded
risksAndControls.recommendedControl: A single unhandled HTTP failure can skip the remaining provisioning chain.

risksAndControls.observation: Existing fields are validated but not remediated
risksAndControls.recommendedControl: Add controlled ALTER/update procedures or fail with actionable remediation.

risksAndControls.observation: Endpoint and execution metadata can contain sensitive data
risksAndControls.recommendedControl: Maintain redaction, avoid secrets, and apply least privilege and retention.
